scope: Recalibrate every major-set symbol placement with independent per-card frame normalization. Old-frame wave first, new-frame wave second. Existing placements are provisional until reassessed. Groups with no printed symbol need explicit not-applicable evidence; unavailable layouts/assets/scans remain in the denominator.

normalizationPolicy.storage: One immutable fit per scan-byte hash, exact frame-template/profile hash, extraction method hash and fit-policy hash; record canonical coordinate convention, forward transform, inverse transform, model, quality, support points and rejection reasons. Reuse the identical fit across symbol candidates.
models: global affine skew when independently supported
normalizationPolicy.selection: Start with the simplest model. Fit only independent outer-frame edges/corners; use disjoint frame samples to accept extra degrees of freedom. Evaluate rotation and skew before declaring recalibration complete. Bound and report corrections. Preserve residuals and geometry differences. Never estimate pose from text, symbols or art, never use local warps or per-card renderer settings.
normalizationPolicy.weakFits: Attempt all cards; preserve raw comparisons and explicit failures. Do not inherit identity/shared normalization silently or remove failed cards from coverage.
normalizationPolicy.history: Historical shared-fit and initial translation-scale reports remain immutable evidence. Previously observed cards are not fresh holdouts.
